high_level_description: The image shows two men standing side by side in front of a backdrop that features the Great Wall of China. Both men are dressed formally in suits and ties, suggesting a formal or diplomatic setting. The man on the left has gray hair and is wearing a dark suit with a pink tie, while the man on the right has short brown hair and is wearing a dark suit with a blue tie. The backdrop behind them includes a scenic view of the Great Wall winding through a mountainous landscape, with some greenery and misty clouds adding to the dramatic effect.
